_comment: Players who paid for garage add-ons BEFORE GarageUpgrades existed (levels were lost from localStorage). restore-garage-upgrades.js grants these levels on-chain WITHOUT charging WATT again. Levels are a FLOOR: a restore never lowers a level a wallet already holds on-chain, so it is safe to re-run. power/cooling have no max; rack max 2; rackgpu max 5. Keys are hardhat network names. Edit per network as reports come in. (BSV is not EVM — GarageUpgrades cannot deploy there, so there is no BSV entry.)
